classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding heights and shadow lengths, then apply a decimal scale factor.

content.prompt: James is $1.7$ m tall and casts a shadow $2$ m long. At the same time, a tower casts a shadow $13$ m long. If the tower is $h$ metres high, solve for $h$.

spec.description: Editable schematic with shadow tip, James and tower in left-to-right order. The shared sloping ray passes through both tops. Nested ground dimensions retain the complete 13 m shadow and its included 2 m interval.
spec.mathematics: Corresponding height-to-shadow ratios are h/13 and 1.7/2. The 13 m measurement is the full shadow length.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown h are visible.

answer.worked:
The triangles are similar, so corresponding lengths are proportional.
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{h}{1.7}&=\frac{13}{2}\\h&=1.7\times6.5\\h&=11.05\text{ m}\end{aligned}$$
